question: After restoring cross-source freshness, should `agent-job.ts` permanently own lifecycle, agent-dedupe, chat-dedupe, and all `agent.wait` waiter resolution?
rationale: The stale-result defect has a narrow mechanical repair, but this protected PR permanently changes the session-state owner boundary and therefore requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the single owner
options.body: Accept the consolidated registry after collision repair, focused regression coverage, base refresh, and exact-head validation.

options.title: Retain split ownership
options.body: Pause the refactor if dedupe-derived terminal state should remain outside the agent job registry.

recommendation.title: Approve the single owner
recommendation.body: Accept the consolidated registry after collision repair, focused regression coverage, base refresh, and exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Terminal-precedence authorship and lifecycle-ownership merge history most strongly connect this person to the contract being changed.
